caption: The drawing depicts a weathered wooden sculpture of a female figure standing upright with her left arm raised and bent above her head, holding a round object. The figure's head is turned slightly to her left. She wears a short draped garment that exposes her right shoulder and wraps around her torso and legs, ending above her knees. The surface of the sculpture is textured and marked with variations in coloration, resembling aged wood in tones of beige, gray, and brown, with darker and lighter streaks accentuating the sculpture's worn appearance. The figure stands on an abstract base with a scroll-like design near her left foot. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background, and at the bottom, the words "DANCING GIRL" are printed in capitals, separated by a horizontal blue-green line.
title: Circus Wagon Figure: "Dancing Girl"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
